reels.title: Who's using port 3000?
reels.summary: whatsup shows every port that’s listening on your machine (dev servers, databases, Docker containers), flags anything exposed to your network, and stops any of them with one key. Written in Rust and fully open source. Pick a good first issue if you want to contribute.
